color.$description: Semantic roles of the default profile. Roles alias primitives only; meaning and permitted uses are in spec/foundations.md.

sunken.$description: Reading and detail panes set below the canvas.

accent.$description: The user's own content set apart from neighbouring surfaces, such as outgoing chat messages. text.default, text.bright, text.muted and text.link keep 4.5:1 on it; text.subtle does not (4.30), so secondary text on it uses text.muted (D-035).

code.$description: Surface a static code block sits on, such as a document's pre: pure black like the canvas (D-023, D-039).

terminal.$description: Surface of a pane that hosts a terminal, around its cell grid (D-023, D-039).

default.$description: D-041 owner correction: rose is the default UI and reading foreground; near-white is reserved for document headings, highlights and contrast-critical fills.

bright.$description: D-041 owner correction: rose is the default UI and reading foreground; near-white is reserved for document headings, highlights and contrast-critical fills.

prose.$description: Neutral long-form reading text; aliases text.default (D-041).

link.$description: Strong red link text, distinct from rose body text and headings; retain the underline.

ring-container.$description: Focus colour for containers and explicitly mapped filled controls (D-015); component rules determine ring geometry.

bg.$description: Selected row, tab, workspace; D-027 recessed the fill, leaving the 2px indicator and the check to carry selection.

bg.$description: D-041 subdued burgundy selection keeps rose text readable in hosts retaining its foreground.

tint.$description: Text selection on hosts that keep the text colour inside a selection. It is translucent, so it also suits hosts that paint the fill over their content. Text drawn on it keeps 4.5:1 over the canvas, raised and accent surfaces; text it is painted over, and links, do not (D-036).

bg.$description: Primary button fill; D-026 darkened it off color12, which stays fixed as heritage ANSI 12.

text.$description: Primary action labels: bright rose across rest, hover and pressed states (D-033).

hover-bg.$description: Primary button hover; pair with action.primary.text (D-033).
